intent: IMPLEMENT TelemetrySampleEvent so the frozen test passes; Java 17, Spring Boot 3, non-blocking, no cross-context domain imports, no hardcoded config values. Spec: Telemetry Intake & Validation (publishes TelemetrySampleValidated / TelemetrySampleValidationFailed) and the downstream contexts: shared kernel event record in package com.pulsestream.telemetry.shared.events (no domain types of any context). Immutable record TelemetrySampleEvent(String deviceId, String metric, double value, Instant tDevice, Instant tIngress, String validationStatus). Constants VALID="VALID" and VALIDATION_FAILED="VALIDATION_FAILED". Method boolean isValidationFailed(). Ordering key is tDevice, never tIngress. Used as the payload of TelemetrySampleValidated, ValidationFailed and TelemetrySampleSequenced events.
